ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: The Kyber Trade
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Ash'karr campaign content: the alleged-Jedi Homestead visit and the donate-and-smuggle plot (KYBER_TRADE_PLOT_1, design/Jawa/kyber_trade_plot_spec.md, K1/K2 RULED 2026-09-11). Ships RUT_KyberHomesteadVisit (a one-shot conversation quest: Homestead Defense League visitors ask how the kyber was obtained; accepting is the Forthright branch, letting it expire is Evasive — no punishment either way) and RUT_KyberDonationSmuggle (the donation-and-rendezvous quest: a fixer on the smuggling lane asks for a real quantity of kyber, given not sold; completing it pays a letter of thanks and a modest Homestead goodwill bump only — zero Heat change, per K2, and no Rebellion faction or presence is ever created). Both quests are pure vanilla QuestScriptDef/QuestNode content (no C#) and are never rolled by the storyteller (rootSelectionWeight 0) — they fire only through the paired RUT_GiveQuest_* IncidentDefs (baseChance 0), the deterministic dev-mode/bridge hook already established by VAULT_THAW_QUEST_FAMILY_1. The GM-layer Heat/Hutt-Interest blackboard that is meant to fire these on a real kyber-sale-count threshold does not exist yet (M4 unstarted per build_plan.md) — see the item file for exactly what that leaves undone. Requires RUT_Jawa_HuttCartel and the HomesteadDefenseLeague patch (both UtinniPatches) to be loaded for their flavor text to make sense, but has no hard load-order dependency on them (no defName from either is referenced).
Ships one small C# assembly (Source/) per the standing Mod Settings rule: a single kill switch (both quests off entirely), read by a plain IncidentWorker_GiveQuest subclass named directly in this mod's own IncidentDefs — no Harmony, same idiom as UtinniPatches' own settings-gated subclasses.
